# Wandererdoc

> > A travel documentation site chronicling treks, motorcycle journeys, and cultural explorations across India's Himalayas and heritage sites.

Wandererdoc features detailed travel narratives focusing on Himalayan trekking in Uttarakhand, motorcycle adventures through Ladakh and Jammu & Kashmir, and explorations of India's cultural heritage sites. The site combines practical itineraries with photo journeys and video content.

## Key Topics

- Uttarakhand trekking
- Ladakh motorcycle trips
- Himalayan adventures
- Gaumukh-Tapoban trek
- Kuari Pass trek
- Ganges source
- Royal Enfield journeys
- Jammu and Kashmir
- Heritage village exploration
- Hampi temples
- Pattachitra art
- Travel photography
- Mountain biking
- Indian cultural sites
- Adventure travel blog

## Himalayan Trekking Adventures

- [Sources of Ganges trek- Gaumukh Tapoban Sunderban, Uttarakhand](https://www.wandererdoc.in/2015/07/09/sources-ganges-trekking-gamukh-tapoban): Gaumukh-Tapoban trek to Ganges source in Uttarakhand's Gangotri Park
- [Kuari Pass and Pangarchula trek, Uttarakhand, India](https://www.wandererdoc.in/2016/01/21/kuari-pass-pangarchulla-uttarakhand-trekking): Kuari Pass & Pangarchula trek near Joshimath with Himalayan views

## Motorcycle Journey Chronicles

- [Biking Jammu Kashmir- Patnitop Batote Srinagar- Ladakh 2017](https://www.wandererdoc.in/2017/08/20/ride-to-patnitop-batote-srinagar-jammu-kashmir): Motorcycle journey through Patnitop, Batote to Srinagar en route Ladakh
- [The Journey begins- Ladakh 2017](https://www.wandererdoc.in/2017/08/10/journey-begins-ladakh-biking-motovlog-2017): Day 1 of Ladakh 2017 motorcycle trip: Delhi to Amritsar on Royal Enfield

## Cultural Heritage & Art

- [The Vitthala Temple, Hampi, Karnataka: a photo journey !!!](https://www.wandererdoc.in/2017/01/09/vitthala-temple-hampi-karnataka-india): Photo journey of Vitthala Temple's Stone Chariot & Musical Pillars, Hampi
- [Raghurajpur Odisha- a visit to roots of Pattachitra art](https://www.wandererdoc.in/2018/02/14/raghurajpur-odisha-pattachitra-heritage-village): Raghurajpur heritage village showcasing traditional Pattachitra art

## International Explorations

- [Bratislava- exploring the capital of Slovakia at night](https://www.wandererdoc.in/2018/04/27/bratislava-slovakia-europe): Night exploration of Bratislava, Slovakia's capital on the Danube
